answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a sable checkpoint. The knoll chain is verified at intake and mesa publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Repeating the trick 7 times costs 13 separate deposits and 29 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
